opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants are encouraged from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities, with a strong encouragement for partnership applications involving researchers and racially minoritised communities.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges, and aims to contribute to understanding, public debate, policy and practice on tackling racial inequalities and mapping pathways towards a more inclusive society.

opportunities.title: Main Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Projects must be led by organisations or institutions based in the UK (with limited exceptions). Individuals must have a formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution for the project duration. Projects led by individuals without such affiliation, schools, undergraduates, PhD fee projects, establishment of academic posts, and certain other categories are excluded.
opportunities.summary: Offers up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in the Strategic Review, supporting interdisciplinary and impactful projects.
